issues.jp_before: 店員[てんいん]さんを呼[よ]ぶときは、「{すいません|cs-sound}！」と言[い]います。
issues.problem: English 'call a waiter' mistranslates 店員 (shop or restaurant staff in general).
issues.action: English changed to 'When you want to get a staff member's attention, you say "Excuse me!"'.

issues.jp_before: あの店[みせ]は、安[やす]くていい{とこ|cs-sound}だよ。
issues.problem: English 'cheap and a nice place' is awkward and misreads 安くて, which gives the reason.
issues.action: English changed to 'That shop is a good place; it's cheap.'

issues.jp_before: 駅[えき]の近[ちか]くの{とこ|cs-sound}で待[ま]ってる。
issues.problem: 駅の近くのとこで is redundant and unnatural; a native speaker would say 駅の近くで.
issues.action: Rewrote as いつもの{とこ|cs-sound}で待[ま]ってるね。 'I'll be waiting at the usual place.'

issues.jp_before: あのゲームは{つまんない|cs-sound}ね。すぐ飽[あ]きた。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the つまんない movie item just before it (same word, same 'boring media' scene).
issues.action: Replaced the line with そんなこと、僕[ぼく]は{知[し]んない|cs-sound}よ。 (知らない → 知んない) for variety.

issues.jp_before: 宿題[しゅくだい]は明日[あした]まで{やんない|cs-sound}よ。
issues.problem: 明日まで with a negative is ambiguous and unnatural for 'not doing it until tomorrow'.
issues.action: Rewrote as 今日[きょう]は宿題[しゅくだい]、{やんない|cs-sound}よ。明日[あした]やる。 'I'm not doing my homework today. I'll do it tomorrow.'
